hypothesis: When prior SOXX 20-session return is positive, completed-minute SOXX dollar-proxy bucket sell pressure is temporary liquidity stress; its interaction should raise five-session fee-net cash-to-SOXX value beyond state, ordinary minute price/volume and each main effect. The proxy is not actual order flow.
source_clock: prior-session SOXX20 return at current09:29, bucket state only after completed bar and feature_available_at<=decision_at; score all source intents before future fill
train: 2018-10-15 through 2019-12-31, known mature H5 labels strictly before 2020-01-01
test: 2020-01-01 through 2020-12-31, year-mature 2020 H5 labels; 2021+ outcomes never accessed
target: saved same-state fixed-share five-session SOXX-HOLD fee-net local value, 0 for valid no-fill attempts; not continuous raw account alpha
control: existing 13 state/ordinary-minute fields from impact source plus bucket_signed_net, sell_pressure, prior_mom20, positive_prior_mom20, bucket_available; no impact_asymmetry factor
model: one weighted StandardScaler plus Ridge(alpha=100) for control, one for candidate; each source day total train weight one; missing numeric controls filled from train-only day-weighted means, bucket unavailable interaction=0 and candidate prediction forced to control
source_gate: source/label identity keys unique; all availability<=decision; >=200 bucket-available days in 2019 and 2020; interaction nonconstant beyond main-effect controls before target read
information_gate: 2020 day-weighted candidate MSE strictly below control and train-day mean, interaction coefficient positive, 10-session day-block lower for control loss minus candidate loss >0
action_gate: score all source intents, first positive prediction buys SOXX otherwise HOLD; >=20 independent changed-action days; candidate minus control and candidate minus HOLD daily fee-net local value means and 10-session block lowers positive, with zero selected unknown outcomes
stop: If any source, information or action gate fails, close fixed version without sign, threshold, window, year, model-capacity or action-size rescue; do not access 2021+ target outcomes or run account
limits: adjusted dated-parent fixed-share local H5 labels
no independent SOXX account or promotion
